column1: # PeptideRanker reference scores (original server outputs) - machine readable
# Verification method (performed by teammate ref-hunter on 2026-10-12):
#   The DSH web_fetch tool failed for EVERY url in this session (TypeError: fetch failed),
#   so retrieval was done with HTTPS GET from the bundled Python 3 (urllib) through the host
#   proxy 127.0.0.1:7897. Sources are stable public APIs, re-fetchable byte-identically:
#   every numeric row below was extracted from a table whose column header literally contains
#   'PeptideRanker'/'Peptide Ranker' and whose article states the server used was
#   http://distilldeep.ucd.ie/PeptideRanker/  (i.e. ORIGINAL web server, not a re-implementation).
#   Scores are kept at the precision printed by the source; do NOT expect them to be identical
#   to the 2010 binary to <1e-6 (web server may have been rebuilt) - use tolerance ~1e-2 first.
# SECTION 1: Figure S3 of Mooney et al. 2012 PLoS ONE (screenshot of the ORIGINAL server output
#   page; 15 peptides, 2-decimal display precision). Highest authority for the original code.
# --- SECTION 1: original paper Fig. S3 (server screenshot), 15 rows ---
# --- SECTION 2: third-party papers, original web server (distilldeep.ucd.ie), >=4 decimals ---
